## Summary

Describe the change, why it is needed, and the relevant issue or owner feedback.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant regression tests added or updated, if behavior changed
- [ ] Full tests, curriculum/library checks, TypeScript check, BSB verification, and build checked as applicable
- [ ] Final PR head commit and GitHub Actions results reported (do not reuse an earlier green run)
- [ ] Manual teacher/browser/PDF testing checklist provided, when relevant

## Living project handoff

Choose the appropriate option:

- [ ] **Feature or bug-fix PR:** Updated [docs/PROJECT-HANDOFF.md](../docs/PROJECT-HANDOFF.md), especially **Current work and upcoming plans**, with accurate status, issue/PR links, package version, and verified date
- [ ] **Not applicable:** documentation-only/administrative change or data-only approved curriculum upload

**Note:** The owner may upload individually approved lesson JSON directly to `main`. Those teacher uploads do **not** require a PR or handoff update. Code PRs should remain unmerged for owner review unless explicitly instructed otherwise.
